data_manipulation_dplyr.filter: filter(df, condition) -> Subsets rows based on logical conditions
data_manipulation_dplyr.mutate: mutate(df, new_col = expression) -> Computes and appends new variables
data_manipulation_dplyr.select: select(df, col1, col2) -> Keeps specified columns
data_manipulation_dplyr.group_by_summarize: df %>% group_by(cat) %>% summarize(mean_val = mean(target)) -> Calculates aggregated metrics

spatial_operations_geosphere.distHaversine: distHaversine(p1, p2) -> Computes shortest distance over a sphere in meters between two point matrices [lon, lat]

visualization_ggplot2.heatmap: ggplot(df, aes(x=lon, y=lat)) + geom_bin2d(binwidth=c(dx, dy)) -> Binned spatial intensity
visualization_ggplot2.lineplot: ggplot(df, aes(x=x_var, y=y_var, color=group)) + geom_line() -> Trend visualization
visualization_ggplot2.bar_plot: ggplot(df, aes(x=x_var, y=count, fill=group)) + geom_col() -> Visualizes discrete quantities
